```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
```

# EvoCDA Allele Counts Analysis (Restricted Variants)

## Load EvoCDA Counts
```{r load-evocda}
evocda_df <- read.csv("EvoCDAPyDESEQ2CountTable.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
evocda_counts <- t(as.matrix(evocda_df))
```

## Prepare Metadata for EvoCDA
```{r metadata-evocda}
samples_e <- colnames(evocda_counts)
condition_e <- ifelse(grepl("^CD19minus", samples_e), "minus", "plus")
coldata_e <- data.frame(
  row.names = samples_e,
  condition = factor(condition_e, levels = c("minus", "plus"))
)
```

## Run DESeq2 for EvoCDA
```{r dds-evocda}
dds_e <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = evocda_counts,
  colData   = coldata_e,
  design    = ~ condition
)

# Set WT as control (optional)
ctrl <- which(rownames(dds_e) == "wt") # COMMENT OUT FOR NO CONTROL
dds_e <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_e, controlGenes = ctrl) # COMMENT OUT FOR NO CONTROL
dds_e <- DESeq(dds_e)
res_e <- results(dds_e, contrast = c("condition", "plus", "minus"))
```

## EvoCDA Results
```{r summary-evocda}
summary(res_e)
head(res_e)
```

```{r write-evocda}
write.csv(as.data.frame(res_e), file = "EvoCDA_DESeq2_results_WTctrl_final.csv")
```

# EvoCDA Allele Counts Analysis (All Variants)

## Load EvoCDA Counts
```{r load-evocda}
evocda_df_allvariants <- read.csv("EvoCDAPyDESEQ2CountTableAllVariants.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
evocda_counts_allvariants <- t(as.matrix(evocda_df_allvariants))
```

## Prepare Metadata for EvoCDA
```{r metadata-evocda}
samples_e <- colnames(evocda_counts_allvariants)
condition_e <- ifelse(grepl("^CD19minus", samples_e), "minus", "plus")
coldata_e <- data.frame(
  row.names = samples_e,
  condition = factor(condition_e, levels = c("minus", "plus"))
)
```

## Run DESeq2 for EvoCDA
```{r dds-evocda}
dds_e_allvariants <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = evocda_counts,
  colData   = coldata_e,
  design    = ~ condition
)

# Set WT as control (optional)
ctrl <- which(rownames(dds_e_allvariants) == "wt") # COMMENT OUT FOR NO CONTROL
dds_e_allvariants <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_e_allvariants, controlGenes = ctrl) # COMMENT OUT FOR NO CONTROL
dds_e_allvariants <- DESeq(dds_e_allvariants)
res_e_allvariants <- results(dds_e_allvariants, contrast = c("condition", "plus", "minus"))
```

## EvoCDA Results
```{r summary-evocda}
summary(res_e_allvariants)
head(res_e_allvariants)
```

```{r write-evocda}
write.csv(as.data.frame(res_e_allvariants), file = "EvoCDA_DESeq2_results_WTctrl_AllVariants_final.csv")
```

## MA Plots
```{r ma-plots, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
plotMA(res_e,   main = "EvoCDA: MA Plot", ylim = c(-5, 5))
plotMA(res_e_allvariants,   main = "EvoCDA All: MA Plot", ylim = c(-5, 5))
```

# EvoCDA per-replicate scores
```{r}
# VST-transform the restricted EvoCDA dataset
vsd_e <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_e, blind = TRUE)
vmat_e <- assay(vsd_e)

# Helper metadata with replicate labels
meta_e <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd_e)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rep = stringr::str_extract(sample, "rep\\d+"))

# Replicates that have BOTH conditions (minus & plus)
reps_e <- intersect(
  meta_e %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "minus") %>% dplyr::pull(rep),
  meta_e %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "plus")  %>% dplyr::pull(rep)
)

# Compute per-replicate LFC = (plus - minus) on the VST (log-like) scale
lfc_list_e <- lapply(reps_e, function(r) {
  s_plus  <- meta_e %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "plus",  rep == r) %>% dplyr::pull(sample)
  s_minus <- meta_e %>% dplyr::filter(condition == "minus", rep == r) %>% dplyr::pull(sample)
  stopifnot(length(s_plus) == 1, length(s_minus) == 1)
  vmat_e[, s_plus, drop = TRUE] - vmat_e[, s_minus, drop = TRUE]
})

lfc_mat_e <- do.call(cbind, lfc_list_e)
colnames(lfc_mat_e) <- reps_e
rownames(lfc_mat_e) <- rownames(vmat_e)

# Save and show correlations
write.csv(lfc_mat_e, file = "EvoCDA_vst_perrep_LFC.csv")
cor_e <- cor(lfc_mat_e, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
print(cor_e)

```

```{r}
pairs(
  lfc_mat_e,
  main = "EvoCDA (restricted): per-replicate VST LFC (plus − minus)",
  pch = 19, cex = 0.4
)
```
